Third-party code in this repository

component where authors licence used for
DiscreteKL mcp/r_pkgs/DiscreteKL/ Di Wang GPL (>= 2) the agent’s discrete-time members internal_discrete and discretekl
DiSKD bregsurv_agent/discrete/diskd.py after the reference implementation of Deng et al. (2026) distributed with the authors’ permission the agent’s network members internal_nn and diskd

References

  • Wang, D., Ye, W., Sung, R., Jiang, H., Taylor, J. M. G., Ly, L. and He, K. (2025). Kullback-Leibler-based discrete failure time models for integration of published prediction models with new time-to-event dataset. The Annals of Applied Statistics 19(2), 1167-1189.
  • Deng, F., Luo, L., Wang, D., Li, Q., Kong, L. and He, K. (2026). Discrete Survival Knowledge Distillation for Competing Risks Analysis. Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 306.
